 Profile Summary  
 A visionary professional with 9+ years of experience  spanning Business Analysis, Project Management, 
Healthcare Operations, Claims Processing, and Process Optimization across Medicare, Medicaid, and 
Commercial healthcare programs. 
 Proven expertise in business requirements elicitation, functional analysis, b usiness-rule validation , 
process mapping, data validation, root -cause analysis, UAT, and solution delivery, effectively translating 
complex healthcare requirements into actionable business and analytical solutions. 
 Strong domain acumen across claims life c ycle, claims adjudication, payment accuracy , payer/provider 
operations, member data, utilization management, and healthcare data analysis, serving as a trusted US 
Healthcare Domain SME. 
 Demonstrated project and delivery leadership  through Agile project lif ecycles, scope management, 
milestone governance, stakeholder workshops, risk mitigation, sprint planning, change management, and 
cross-functional collaboration with global teams and senior stakeholders. 
 Spearheaded AI-enabled process transformation using Microsoft Copilot, automating and optimizing 20+ 
manual workflows and supporting the development/automation of 50+ operational reports and 
dashboards, strengthening delivery efficiency, reporting governance, and decision support. 
 Proven capability in managing end-to-end project lifecycles, encompassing scope definition, requirement 
planning, stakeholder alignment, risk mitigation, milestone governance, Agile sprint planning, change 
management, UAT, and delivery tracking, while coordinating cross -functional teams to ensure on -time, 
quality-driven execution of strategic healthcare initiatives.
